name: GhostSpinner
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostSpinner. Same label plus tone and size. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written because the wrapper is a .ts defineComponent.

props.name: label
props.description: Status message forwarded to the unstyled GhostSpinner as visually hidden live-region content.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent. The default omits data-tone so CSS can treat a missing hook as accent.

props.name: size
props.description: Compact status size. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The status span inside the display:contents themed scope. The spinning ring is a ::before pseudo-element so the hidden label is not transformed.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-spinner-size
cssProperties.description: Em-relative ring size. Themed sm/md/lg change font-size so this scales.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-spinner-width
cssProperties.description: Stroke width of the spinning ring.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-spinner-duration
cssProperties.description: Rotation period. The reduced-motion pulse uses the same period so it does not flicker.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-sm-font
cssProperties.description: Font size that scales the em-relative ring for size sm.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-md-font
cssProperties.description: Font size that scales the em-relative ring for size md.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-lg-font
cssProperties.description: Font size that scales the em-relative ring for size lg.
